rules.text: Every SDL event the game polls is passed to ImGui_ImplSDL3_ProcessEvent before the next ImGui frame starts.

probes.check: am_probe_imgui_sdl3_events(): pushes a synthetic SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_MOTION, polls SDL's events into am_pair_imgui_sdl3_process_event, begins a frame with am_pair_imgui_sdl3_new_frame, and checks ImGui's io.MousePos matches it.

seeded_violation.description: Skip the ImGui_ImplSDL3_ProcessEvent call in am_pair_imgui_sdl3_process_event().

probes.check: The lifecycle probe checks this recipe's shutdown ordering constraints.

seeded_violation.description: Call ImGui_ImplSDLGPU3_Shutdown before SDL_WaitForGPUIdle in am_pair_imgui_sdl3_shutdown().

adaptation_notes: am_pair_imgui_sdl3_shutdown() calls SDL_WaitForGPUIdle first: the renderer backend releases GPU resources the device may still be using.

A game's frame loop uses the frame in pieces: it polls SDL's events itself and passes each to am_pair_imgui_sdl3_process_event(), calls am_pair_imgui_sdl3_new_frame(), draws with ImGui, and after its own render passes calls am_pair_imgui_sdl3_render(commands, target), which draws ImGui over the target in a pass of its own. To draw ImGui inside one of the game's passes instead, call am_pair_imgui_sdl3_prepare(commands) before the pass begins and am_pair_imgui_sdl3_draw(commands, pass) inside it.

am_pair_imgui_sdl3_begin_frame() and am_pair_imgui_sdl3_end_frame() are the whole frame for a testbed with nothing else to draw: they poll every event, clear the swapchain and submit, so a game with its own events and passes doesn't call them.
Both backends must shut down before ImGui::DestroyContext(), which asserts otherwise.
